summary.en: A ruled ledger page that holds the count as hand-drawn dots: a small titled card that pushes in to the full page, its rules leaving and returning.
summary.zh: 用手绘圆点装计数的格线账页：带标题的小卡片原地推成整页，格线退下又回来。

fits: Holding every counted item as a dot so later scenes can sort the same dots.
notFor: Exact tables; counts over a few thousand.

intent.en: Let the viewer see the count as a heap of real items, the same heap that will be sorted into the answer.
intent.zh: 让观众把计数看成一堆真东西，后面正是这堆被分成答案。

content.en: A title (≤ 16 / 8) and a number of dots (up to about 1,200).

fits.zh: 把数到的每件事装成一颗点，后面的场景再分同一批点。

notFor.zh: 精确表格；几千以上的数量。

en: The dots are illustrative positions; say so with the dashed note.
zh: 点的位置是示意，配虚线注说明。

overlaps.note: a grid of squares beside a big number (keynote); here a heap of dots on a ruled page

waive.all: an own brick split from teach-video's terminal-ledger kit: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the kit's approved example film at the same moments (the style's recipe, card: Differs from upstream)
